transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I came in because I’ve been trying to make my art into a freelance business, and it’s been getting to me more than I expected. I get really wound up about invoices and client messages, then I avoid dealing with them. Sometimes I end up crying at my kitchen table, or I forget ordinary things, like paying a bill.
Did these difficulties begin only after you started your freelance business, or have you struggled with similar issues throughout your life?
It really started about a month after I took on the community arts contract and tried to make the business more formal. Before that, I wasn’t getting this overwhelmed and avoidant.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing your art or other activities you normally enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear change in that.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say it’s most of the day, nearly every day. It’s more that I get upset when I’m dealing with the business stuff.
Are your worries mostly focused on your freelance business, or do you find yourself excessively worrying about many other everyday topics as well?
Mostly the business. I get really wound up about invoices and client messages, and then I avoid dealing with them. It kind of spirals from there.
